summary: 组织心理学家尼科尔森用演化心理学解释现代职场中的信任、合作与冲突。他认为人在管理制度改变时仍会保留某些倾向，并据此讨论企业怎样调整组织方式。
logic: 由达尔文引入组织心理学
检验心灵如白纸的假设
联系演化倾向与职场行为
考察管理建议及其应用难题

paragraphs.brief: 查尔斯·达尔文，杰出的人类学家和进化理论的创造者，通常不与现代商业世界相关。
sentences: Charles Darwin, the brilliant anthropologist and creator of the theory of evolution, is not normally associated with the modern business world.
查尔斯·达尔文，杰出的人类学家和进化理论的创造者，通常不与现代商业世界相关。

Nevertheless, Darwinian evolutionary theory is the foundation of a new wave of ideas about human behaviour in general and particularly the way people behave in the workplace; these ideas have given the title of ‘evolutionary psychology’.
然而，达尔文进化理论是关于人类行为，特别是人们在工作场所的行为方式的一波新思想的基础；这些思想称为“进化心理学”。
Evolutionary psychology revolves around the notion that our brains, like our bodies, have an inherited evolutionary design that has scarcely changed for 10,000 years.
进化心理学围绕这个概念即我们的大脑，像我们的身体一样，拥有一个继承的进化设计已经一万年来几乎没有改变。
As respected evolutionary psychology experts Leda Cosmides and John Tooby comment, ‘our modern skulls house a Stone Age mind’.
作为受人尊敬的进化心理学专家 Leda Cosmides 和 John Tooby 评论，“我们现代的头骨是石器时代的思想”。

The US biologist Edward O. Wilson sees evolutionary psychology as being a discipline which is based on both sociobiology, which is the study of the biological basis of social behaviour, and psychology, which is the systematic study of human behaviour.
美国生物学家Edward O.Wilson认为进化心理学是一种基于社会生物学的学科，即研究社会行为的生物基础，而心理学则是系统研究人类行为。

paragraphs.brief: Nigel Nicholson是伦敦商学院的组织心理学家，是进化心理学的坚定支持者。在这个问题上，他出版了《人类动物的管理》。
sentences: Nigel Nicholson, an organisational psychologist from the London Business School, is a strong supporter of evolutionary psychology and on this subject has published Managing the Human Animal.
Nigel Nicholson是伦敦商学院的组织心理学家，是进化心理学的坚定支持者。在这个问题上，他出版了《人类动物的管理》。

His book takes the reader on a journey from the Stone Age plains of the savannah to the modern office, and includes a discussion of Darwinism and behavioural psychology, together with a dissection of dysfunctional organisational behaviour.
他的书让读者从稀树草原的石器时代平原到现代办公室，并包括讨论达尔文主义和行为心理学，以及组织行为不灵解。
It is an effective approach explaining why people behave as they do, particularly at work.
这是一种有效的方法，可以解释人们为何表现得像他们一样，特别是在工作时。
Evolutionary psychology is increasingly being cited in management circles, where managers are trying to understand puzzling aspects of human behaviour and, by doing so, improve the workplace.
管理层越来越多地引用进化心理学，管理人员试图了解人类行为中令人困惑的方面，从而改善工作场所。
Nicholson believes that evolutionary psychology can help managers understand what goes wrong in organisational life and what they can do about it.
Nicholson认为，进化心理学可以帮助管理人员了解组织生活中出错的原因，以及他们能够做些什么。

paragraphs.brief: 由于图比和科西米德斯的压力，还没有足够多的一代人来适应一个适应后工业生活的大脑通过自然选择来进化。
sentences: Nicholson maintains that evolutionary psychology dismisses the long-held assumption that our minds are like blank pages just waiting for culture and experience to write on them and shape our nature.
尼克尔森认为，进化心理学排除了长期的假设我们的思想就像空白的页面只是等待文化和经验在上面写作和塑造我们的自然。

He points out that sophisticated research shows the brain actually houses a store of knowledge when we are born, and now genetic research is establishing there are certain genes that account for abilities, tastes and tendencies.
他指出，尖端的研究显示大脑实际上拥有知识储备当我们出生，现在基因研究正在建立某些基因考虑的能力，品味和趋势。
The stored knowledge in the human brain has not changed much since the Stone Age.
自石器时代以来，人类大脑中储存的知识没有多大变化。
As Tooby and Cosmides stress, there have not been enough generations for a brain that is well-adapted to our post-industrial life to evolve through natural selection.
由于图比和科西米德斯的压力，还没有足够多的一代人来适应一个适应后工业生活的大脑通过自然选择来进化。

paragraphs.brief: 尽管如此，商业界还是强调理性而不是情感行为，不承认情感的重要性。
sentences: The evolutionary psychology version of human nature revolves around some key elements which we have inherited from our hunter-gatherer minds.
人类自然的进化心理学围绕我们从狩猎采集者的头脑中继承的一些关键元素
One key element is emotion.
一个关键因素是情感。
Emotion was originally essential to keep early man alive and safe from predators.
情感是让早期人活着远离掠食者的关键
Emotion was, and continues to be, our radar, guiding us throughout today’s techno-defined business world.
情感曾经是，而且现在仍然是我们的雷达，在当今的技术定义商业世界中指引着我们。
Despite this, the business world emphasises rational, not emotional, behaviour, and does not admit the importance of emotion.
尽管如此，商业界还是强调理性而不是情感行为，不承认情感的重要性。
We still use the emotional part of our minds to make sense of other people’s behaviour and to create an impression, so we can often be taken in by appearances.
我们仍在用我们思想中的情感部分来理解其他人的行为，并制造一种印象，这样我们往往可以被外表所吸引。
This mental predisposition actually works best in small communities (the tribe), not in much larger environments filled with people we barely know (the modern workplace).
这种心理倾向实际上在小社区(部落)中最有效，而不是在我们几乎不认识的人(现代工作场所)所组成的大得多的环境中。
Our minds naturally try to re-create our ancestral communities with networks of no more than 150 people, where there are clear hierarchies and leaders.
我们的思想自然地试图重建我们的祖先社区，其网络不超过150人，那里有明确的等级和领导人。

As a consequence, it takes very little to trigger people’s innate distrust of others because our safety in antiquity depended on supporting our near family and friends, whom we valued more than other people.
其结果是，人们对他人的内在不信任几乎不会引发，因为我们在古代时期的安全依赖于支持我们的近亲和朋友，我们比其他人更珍视他们。

paragraphs.brief: Nicholson承认，在商业界，并非每个人都同意他对工作场所进化心理学有效性的信念。
sentences: So what advice does Nicholson have for the corporate world?
Nicholson对公司有什么建议？

He thinks that by knowing the reasons for people’s behaviour it is possible to mould corporate environments into places that have more chance of working efficiently and being pleasant places to work in.
他认为，通过了解人们行为的原因，有可能将公司环境塑造为更有机会高效工作和更舒适的工作场所。
Nicholson admits that not everybody in the business world agrees with his belief in the effectiveness of evolutionary psychology in the workplace.
Nicholson承认，在商业界，并非每个人都同意他对工作场所进化心理学有效性的信念。

One group that resists the theory of evolutionary psychology is young MBA graduates who are just beginning their careers and feel that evolutionary psychology will make their lives at work more difficult.
一个抵制进化心理学理论的团体是年轻的MBA毕业生他们刚刚开始职业生涯并且觉得进化心理学将使他们的工作生活更加困难。
Older and wiser executives point out that they still tend to cling to the idea of a magic formula to bring people into line with corporate strategy.
更年长、更明智的管理人员指出，他们仍然倾向于坚持一种神奇的公式，使人民符合公司战略。
But that is back-to-front thinking, according to Nicholson, who contends that we should be reinventing our business structures, not our fundamental human nature.
但是，根据Nicholson的说法，这是背对背的想法，他主张我们应该重新塑造我们的商业结构，而不是我们的基本人性。

paragraphs.brief: 尼科尔森承认，在将进化心理学思想转化为实际的主张方面，还有很长的路要走，但他相信，越来越多的人会走他的思维方式。
sentences: At the end of his book, Nicholson gives his forecast of what will and will not change in the business world.
尼克尔森在书的结尾预测了商业界会和不会发生什么变化
He believes that most people will still prefer more traditional forms of work and throughout their lives will continue to aim at lifelong status advancement.
他认为，大多数人仍然倾向于更传统的工作形式，并且在整个一生中将继续追求终身地位的提高。

He also maintains that the line between work and home will be less defined, but that people will prefer traditional working patterns if working from home leaves them isolated from their work community.
他还认为，工作与家庭之间的界限将不太明确，但是，如果在家工作使他们与工作社区隔绝，人们将更倾向于传统的工作模式。
He doubts that the high-tech ideas of virtual companies will ever be very successful because people will still want to meet each other face-to-face.
他怀疑虚拟公司的高科技想法是否会非常成功，因为人们仍然想面对面地见面。

Nicholson describes his ideal organisation in the future: it would be decentralised, with small sub-units; the staff would be from diverse backgrounds and be allowed a high degree of self-determination.
Nicholson描述了他将来的理想组织：它将分散管理，设有小型分股；工作人员将来自不同背景，并被允许高度自决。
New endeavours and creativity would replace systems and rationality.
新的努力和创造性将取代系统和理性。

Nicholson acknowledges that there is a long way to go in terms of the translation of his ideas of evolutionary psychology into practical propositions, but he is confident more and more people will come round to his way of thinking.
尼科尔森承认，在将进化心理学思想转化为实际的主张方面，还有很长的路要走，但他相信，越来越多的人会走他的思维方式。

correct: explain the theory of evolutionary psychology.
解释进化心理学的理论

items.en: In the third paragraph, which view about evolutionary psychology matches Nicholson’s opinion?
items.zh: 第三段，关于进化心理学的哪一种观点与Nicholson的观点相符？
correct: We inherit ideas and characteristics from our ancestors.
我们继承了祖先的思想和特征。

items.en: The writer discusses the key element of emotion in order to
items.zh: 作者讨论情感的关键元素
correct: explain attitudes and actions at work.

items.en: Which of the following does Nicholson predict will happen in the business world?
items.zh: 尼科尔森预测商业界会发生以下什么情况？
correct: Social interaction will remain important to workers.
社会互动对工人仍然很重要。

items.en: Which of the following is the most suitable title for Reading Passage 3?
items.zh: 下列哪一个标题最适合第三篇阅读文章？
correct: Understanding the origins of workplace behaviour.
了解工作场所行为的起源。

items.en: Nicholson makes a persuasive argument in his book.
items.zh: 尼克尔森在他的书里提出了说服力的论点
items.why: 作者对 Nicholson的方法作出正面评价=“论证有说服力”。

items.en: Tooby and Cosmides believe natural selection through the generations has prepared us for modern times.
items.zh: 托比和科斯米德相信世世代代的自然选择为我们准备了现代。
items.why: 题干说Tooby & Cosmides 认为自然选择已经让我们为现代做好准备。原文说还不够代际一与题干相反。

items.en: Our reliance on technology causes emotional problems in the workplace.
items.zh: 我们对技术的依赖在工作场所造成了情感问题。
items.why: 作者把情绪比作当代科技化商业环境中的“雷达”，说明它能引导行为。没有提出依赖科技会导致职场情绪问题。

items.en: People today are more trusting than they used to be.
items.zh: 今天的人比他们以前更信任
items.why: 文章借祖先依靠亲友求生来解释今天的人为何容易对外人产生不信任。它没有比较古今的信任程度或说今天的人更容易信任他人。

clauses: He points out … now genetic research is establishing there are certain genes that account for abilities, tastes and tendencies.
“that sophisticated research shows the brain actually houses a store of knowledge when we are born, and”补足 points 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 points 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
One group … is young MBA graduates who are just beginning their careers and feel that evolutionary psychology will make their lives at work more difficult.
